scope: Read-only identification and price research for the unusable M.2 bay retainer on the Strix host. No order, seller inquiry, disassembly, reboot, stress test, or Strix configuration change was made.

host.serial_privacy: Serial retained as masked; Asus-Parts serial lookup resolved the chassis as ASUS ROG G615LW.
host.identity_interpretation: The machine is hybrid or modified: firmware/board identity is G615LP, while the chassis serial resolves as G615LW. The M.2 latch is motherboard-mounted, so serial-only fitment is not authoritative for this unit.

mechanism.operation: Rotate latch knob counterclockwise to release and clockwise to lock; both M.2 SSD slots use the same procedure.
mechanism.customer_guide_observation: The left and right sequences show a dark plastic cam/lever centered on a small circular pivot, with a brass-colored pivot visible in the manual photographs. No separate M.2 screw, spring slider, or driver step is shown.
mechanism.classification: ASUS 2025 ROG tool-less rotating cam SSD latch, not the older desktop-board twist Q-Latch and not a normal screw/standoff.

official_documents.title: G635L_G615L_G615J Service Manual for English Edition
official_documents.evidence: Major components item 25 is SSD latch. M.2 removal says to turn latch knob(s) counterclockwise; installation says clockwise. The plural applies to both slots.

official_documents.title: G615LR_LW_LH_LM_LP_JM_JMR_JH_JHR_JPR_G635LX_LR_LW Customer self repair guide
official_documents.evidence: The covered model list includes G615LW and G615LP. Separate left and right M.2 photo sequences both say rotate the SSD LATCH; both show the same cam/pivot mechanism.

candidate_part.classification: The only separately cataloged ASUS SSD LOCK LATCH found by exact-name search.
candidate_part.image_observation: Official photos show one loose, asymmetric black plastic cam with a projecting pin and hooked/fingered end. No scale, second handed part, screw, coil spring, or metal insert is visible.

supports: The official service manual uses the same SSD latch mechanism for G635 and G615 families, including both G615LP and G615LW in the customer guide model list.
Impact Computers lists this SKU as compatible with a different G615 variant, G615LM, in addition to G635/G815/G835 models.
opposes: The ASUS PartShop product is named for G635LX and does not publicly list a compatibility table.
The Asus-Parts serial lookup resolved this chassis as ASUS ROG G615LW and its product compatibility checker returned: This part does not fit your ASUS ROG G615LW.
Neither the G615LW nor G615LP Asus-Parts model catalog lists a separately purchasable SSD lock latch.
fitment_evidence.decision: Do not treat 13NR0L80P10011 as an exact confirmed replacement without a physical comparison, a molded part number, or ASUS confirmation for this LP/LW hybrid board.

price_snapshots.price_display: Quote; regular and sale placeholders are $0.00.
price_snapshots.availability: Notify me; no live stock or sell price.
price_snapshots.compatibility: Lists G615LM plus G815LP/G835LW/G835LX among compatibles, but not G615LP or G615LW.

price_snapshots.generic_warning: A $10.99 ASUS M.2 Q-LATCH 13M0000T04011 listing appears under broader terms, but that is the older desktop twist-collar Q-Latch and is not this laptop cam.

fallback_observation.interpretation: A whole new G615LW mainboard is technically available but is not a sensible route for one plastic latch.

non_claims: The bay was not disassembled or photographed, so this research does not determine whether the failed left or right latch is broken, lost, cracked, or seized.
No exact replacement SKU is confirmed for the G615LP board installed in this chassis.
13NR0L80P10011 is the strongest public candidate, not a proven exact fit.
No shipping quote, tax calculation, order, reservation, or seller inquiry was made.
The official product image has no scale, and absolute dimensions or left/right handedness were not measured.
The brass-colored pivot material and internal spring/post construction cannot be proven from the manual photographs.
The generic 13M0000T04011 Q-Latch is not this mechanism and should not be ordered for this repair.
A whole mainboard is listed as a fallback source of the latch, but compatibility with this exact hybrid configuration and the practicality of transplanting the latch were not tested.
